channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: mnemosyne (Memory & Context)
item.description: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer designed for AI agents. It provides memory management through a Python SDK, MCP server, or plugins for various platforms.

item.title: keep (Memory & Context)
item.description: Keep is a reflective memory system for AI agents that facilitates long-term learning and contextual awareness. It processes diverse inputs—including URLs, codebases, and multimedia—by summarizing, embedding, and organizing them into a searchable graph. The system uses 'edge tags' to create navigable relationships between notes, such as linking speakers to transcripts or commits to files. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other MCP-compatible tools to help agents track intentions and r

item.title: hermes-studio (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Studio is a desktop application, local runtime, and web console for Hermes Agent. It provides tools for agent chat, visual workflow construction, model management, and multi-platform channel configuration.

item.title: clawshell (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: ClawShell is a security-privileged process that acts as a safety harness for the Hermes Agent ecosystem by protecting sensitive credentials and PII. It functions as a proxy between the agent and upstream LLM providers, swapping virtual keys for real ones stored in a restricted directory to ensure the agent never has direct access to credentials. The system performs Data Loss Prevention (DLP) scanning to redact or block sensitive information in request and response bodies. Additionally, it provid

item.title: lintlang (Developer Tools)
item.description: lintlang is a deterministic static linter for AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It uses seven structural detectors and six HERM v1.1 scoring dimensions to identify patterns without model or network calls.

item.title: minions (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Minions is a centralized management interface for Hermes Agent that replaces fragmented terminal sessions with a unified dashboard. It utilizes a Kanban-style board to track persistent agent sessions, allowing users to monitor reasoning, tool calls, and task progress in real time. The system enforces a human-in-the-loop workflow where agents propose completions that require manual verification before being marked as done. Users can also manage scheduled recurring jobs and browse agent-created fi

item.title: Hermes-CN-Desktop (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Agent CN Desktop is a desktop client for Hermes Agent developed by the Hermes Agent Chinese Community. It provides a native window interface for Windows and macOS using Tauri, Rust, and React.

item.title: WeSight (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: WeSight is an open-source desktop control console for local AI agents, providing a visual workspace to manage coding agents, tool execution, and file changes. It supports the installation and configuration of multiple agent engines and model providers through a unified graphical interface.

item.title: Token Monitor (Developer Tools)
item.description: Token Monitor is a desktop widget for Windows, macOS, and Linux that tracks live token usage and account limits across more than 28 AI coding tools. It provides a dashboard for monitoring historical trends, costs, and session details with real-time synchronization across multiple devices.

item.title: PM Skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: PM Skills is an open-source library of 822 agent skills formatted as plain markdown files to guide AI assistants in performing professional tasks. Each skill includes a framework, output template, quality checks, and anti-patterns for use with tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Hermes Agent.

item.title: Codeg (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Codeg is a multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from various AI coding agents into a single searchable interface. It allows users to delegate tasks to sub-agents via mentions and supports running as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container.

item.title: Hermes Agent 中文站 (Guides & Docs)
item.description: This repository provides Chinese-language practical documentation for Hermes Agent. It includes guides for initial setup, local deployment, domestic model integration, and migration from OpenClaw.

item.title: Awesome Hermes Agent (Guides & Docs)
item.description: This project is a curated list of resources, tools, and projects for Hermes Agent, a self-improving AI agent by Nous Research. It includes links to official documentation, deployment options, skills, and various community integrations.

item.title: HermesAgent-MultiModel (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: HermesAgent-MultiModel is a local-first AI agent framework that uses Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) orchestration to route tasks to specialized models. It integrates with Hermes and Ollama to run agentic workflows on consumer GPUs without cloud dependencies.

item.title: Hermes Agent (Persian Docs) (Guides & Docs)
item.description: This repository contains a complete Persian translation of the official Hermes Agent documentation. The project uses GitHub Pages and includes full support for right-to-left (RTL) text direction.

item.title: Hermes Agent Mobile (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: This project enables the Hermes AI agent framework to run on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It allows users to interact with multiple AI personas through a CLI or via Telegram using an API key.

item.title: Hermy HQ (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermy HQ is a self-hostable dashboard template designed to manage a local Hermes AI agent through a shared Postgres database acting as a message bus. Users can dispatch tasks, review agent plans, and manage memory via a web interface while the agent remains on a local machine.

item.title: Hermex (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to control a self-hosted hermes-webui server. It serves as a mobile interface for managing an AI agent, allowing users to interact with their agent while keeping data and compute on their own hardware.

item.title: Memory OS (Memory & Context)
item.description: Memory OS is a local memory infrastructure for Hermes Agent that utilizes a seven-layer system to store and retrieve information across sessions. It integrates SQLite, Qdrant, and Redis to provide structured fact storage, semantic search, and an auto-curated wiki pipeline while remaining compatible with various LLM providers.

item.title: hermes-usage-hook (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Usage Hook is a Hermes Agent plugin that appends LLM provider rate-limit usage to the end of replies. It detects the provider from the model name and displays usage for available windows, such as 5-hour or weekly windows.

item.title: hermes-local-knowledge (Memory & Context)
item.description: Hermes Local Knowledge is a Hermes Agent plugin designed to route local questions to specific artifacts such as skills, scripts, runbooks, or MCP servers. It functions as an artifact router rather than a chunk-based RAG system, providing search results as routing hints for the agent.

item.title: fruvisi (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: FruVisi is a dashboard plugin for Hermes Agent that provides an interactive 2D organizational chart for managing agent structures. It enables functional presets for team lineups, per-agent OpenRouter fallbacks, and kanban task integration via the native Hermes API.

item.title: MongrelDB-Hermes (Memory & Context)
item.description: MongrelDB-Hermes is a hybrid memory provider for the Hermes Agent that utilizes multiple index types for semantic, keyword, and exact text retrieval. It includes built-in AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both native in-process and HTTP daemon execution modes.

item.title: agentiker-scout (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: agentiker-scout is a Hermes plugin providing tools for code and architecture analysis, vulnerability scanning, and autonomous web research. It utilizes a shared pattern pipeline to allow findings from analysis scans to inform automated bug-hunt scans.

item.title: agentiker-plan-follow (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: plan_follow is a Hermes plugin for structured plan creation and task enforcement. It provides tools for managing task dependencies, parallel execution groups, review gates, and git integration.

item.title: TradingAgents (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: TradingAgents is a multi-agent framework designed for research that uses LLM-powered agents to simulate trading firm dynamics. The framework decomposes trading tasks into specialized roles including analysts, a trader, risk management, and a portfolio manager.

item.title: swarm-tips (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Swarm Tips provides Solana programs and an MCP server for an AI agent platform. The platform includes a social deduction game and a task marketplace for AI agents.

item.title: agentiker-code-intel (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: agentiker-code-intel is a Hermes plugin providing AST-aware code intelligence using tree-sitter, ast-grep, and LSP. It offers 70 tools for tasks such as symbol extraction, structural search, and impact analysis across supported languages.

item.title: china-briefing (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: China Briefing is a multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator designed for Hermes Agent. It generates structured reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales using Tavily API for web searches.

item.title: agentcairn (Memory & Context)
item.description: Agentcairn provides durable context for coding agents by storing memory as Markdown files in a user-controlled vault. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports cross-agent memory sharing.
